description.text: Find your path into CIC, from campuses for work, labs and events to CIC Catalyst services for programs, partnerships and ecosystem strategy.

targetApplicants.text: CIC Labs and Innovation Campuses help science and technology teams spin up faster without building a lab from scratch. Get specialized space, shared resources, and operational support that reduce overhead, all within a broader innovation environment with business support, programming, and potential partners close by.
